title.zh: 测试分模块：单元与冒烟都能只跑相关的部分
title.en: Modular tests: unit and smoke runs can select just the relevant modules

intent.zh: 按"测试文件也分模块"重排：单元测试入口带模块表（`--only a,b` / `--list`，不给参数才跑全部 = 总测试）；冒烟拆成 tests\smoke\ 下一模块一文件（common + entry/typing/safety/features/loops/region/record/serve/act/flowloops），运行器 `-Only` / `-List`，靶子启动这类基建下沉到 common，任何模块都能单独跑。平时只跑改到的模块，功能定稿后再跑 verify.ps1（= 总测试）。
intent.en: Rearranged so tests are modular too: the unit-test entry gained a module table (--only a,b / --list, and no arguments runs everything = the full test); the smoke suite was split into one file per module under tests\smoke\ (common plus entry/typing/safety/features/loops/region/record/serve/act/flowloops) behind a runner with -Only / -List, and infrastructure like starting the target moved into common so any module runs on its own. Day to day you run only the modules you touched; verify.ps1 (the full test) comes out when a feature is settled.

acceptance: 单元测试：--list 列出 8 个模块；--only loops 只跑该模块；不给参数跑全部
冒烟：-List 列出 10 个模块；-Only <模块> 只跑它且不依赖其它模块（靶子由 common 启动）
拆分不改变覆盖面：全部模块跑下来仍是 118 项通过（与拆分前一致）
未知模块名退出码 2 并提示 -List
每个模块 = tests/smoke 下一个文件，结构数据里的模块与文件一一对应
note: 测试分模块：单元入口带模块选择，冒烟一模块一文件 + 运行器 -Only/-List，基建（靶子、编码自检、剪贴板）下沉 common；全量仍 118 项通过。
